text_caveat: OCR TEXT OF A SCAN, NOT A CLEAN TRANSCRIPTION. It carries the original OCR errors (e.g. "often" for "of ten", run-together or broken words, stray punctuation from stamps and signatures), marginal notes interleaved with the body where the OCR placed them, and some paragraphs out of order where the OCR read columns out of sequence. Characters that could not be mapped are shown as [?] (240 of them). Read against the scan before relying on any figure. Not checked for later amendments.
why_this_instrument: The contributory pension scheme for employees in the public service and the private sector (s. 2: in the private sector, organisations with 15 or more employees; employees of organisations with fewer than three employees and the self-employed may join): the contribution rates (s. 4: at least 10% employer, 8% employee of monthly emoluments; group life insurance), exemptions (s. 5), retirement benefits and withdrawals (ss. 7 and 16), and the tax exemption of contributions and benefits (s. 10).
